title: Spanish H Disappears (quiz-first)
voice_notes: Remix variant - reuses lesson-25-silent-h audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: Try the word hospital, with no h sound.
Spanish has one letter you should completely ignore.
The letter h is written, but it does not make a sound.
C H together still makes the ch sound. But a plain h disappears.
segments.show:
ch is different
plain h disappears

segments.say: Do not even give it a tiny breath. Imagine the word starts with the next vowel.
segments.show:
no breath
start at the vowel

segments.say: Good. The letter is there for your eyes, not your mouth.
segments.show:
for your eyes
not your mouth

caption: Could you say it before the reveal? Hospital, with zero h sound.
